title: versioned S5000 single-GPU parameter registry and interpretable development model

prediction_policy.gemm: 2*M*N*K operations divided by an exact full-condition effective TFLOP/s lookup; shape transfer is deferred to P6
prediction_policy.memory: logical payload divided by an exact full-condition logical GB/s lookup including working-set, access pattern and layout fields; rate transfer is deferred to P6
prediction_policy.resource: resident CTA is reported only where an exact source/resource match exists; otherwise unknown
prediction_policy.tail: only the P4.2 dependent-compute kernel family carries its measured 0.392-2.790 us conditional interval; no universal tail term is applied

unknown_policy: unknown or conditional intervals are emitted verbatim; no global residual correction or undocumented architecture constant is allowed
